hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r changed_file; case "$changed_file" in *mechanistic_pathway_learning/*.py|*tests/*.py) cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 nice -n 15 python3 -m pytest tests/ -q || exit 2 ;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r changed_file; case "$changed_file" in *docs/*.md|*README.md|*CLAUDE.md|*configs/documentation_registry.json|*configs/registered_rules.json) cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 nice -n 15 python3 -m pytest tests/test_documentation_process.py tests/test_amendment_history.py -q || exit 2 ;; esac; }
hooks.statusMessage: Checking the documents against the register, the manifests and the git log
